title: 10 Year Anniversary (ORIGINAL)
description: I can barely believe it myself but 2026 marks my ten year anniversary with making erotic audio content! A special thank you to Skymogul who made this lovely trip down memory lane video starting from my first nervous live performance, all the way through to the construction of my dungeon and my new puppies entering the world. To celebrate, I thought it might be nice to give all my faithful followers who've stuck with me all this time a present too. Here are a whole bunch of previously exclusive files that are now going free. There are some forgotten oldies in there, some guided meditations and everything in between. Enjoy! You can browse through them all on their own little dedicated Mini Series on the 'Dex too. - Two Sides of the Coin - Monster Brothel for Cute Girls - A Happy Little Induction - Bound to the Bed Deepener - You Make Me So Happy - Another Futa Fantasy - Cast Asleep by An Enchantress - Blurred Reality - Every Word I Say - Liquid Metal Induction - Breathe In My Control - Licking My Clit While I Suck Your Mind Away - Moving Images Induction - Tomboy Cuddleslut - Give it Up Loop - Floating in My Control - Productivity Loop - Sleepy, Happy, Comfy - Helping the Hairdresser - The Power of Acceptance - Four Stages of Meditation I just want to say a giant thank you from the bottom of my heart to everyone who has supported me along the way. Whether that be by supporting me on Patreon or even simply listening and letting me whisk you away with my voice. The last ten years have been a rollercoaster but I wouldn't change it for anything. I hope you'll still be here for the next ten because I am no where near done playing with you!
author: Mistress Shibby
